column2: PART  IV(A) – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 24.12.2019
After  purchasing  stores  goods  those  should  be  documented  without  a  delay  and  date  and  number  of  vouncher
relevant for the purchasing should be mentioned accordingly.
Any inventory good should not be released without a releasing order from an officer with powers and at the end
of every financial year investigation report should be obtained for the investigation about inventory goods under
an investigation board explained by these rules.
